Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Aditya Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. Sushil Vashisth, learned Standing Counsel for the
State.
3. Petitioners are serving as Junior Engineer in State
Public Works Department. They have raised a seniority
dispute in this writ petition. As according to them, their
seniority was wrongly determined in the final seniority list
dated 04.10.2023.
4. Learned State Counsel submits that seniority dispute
by Public Servants can be raised before the Tribunal
established under U.P. Public Service Tribunals Act, 1976.
He further submits that since petitioners have a statutory
remedy, therefore, writ petition is liable to be dismissed on
the ground of alternate remedy.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner does not dispute the
submission made by learned State Counsel. He, however,
submits that there is some seniority dispute going on before
Tribunal in Claim Petition No.138 of 2022.
6. Since similar matters are pending consideration before
the Tribunal, therefore, it is all the more reason for the
petitioners to approach the Tribunal.
7. The writ petition is accordingly dismissed on the
ground of alternate remedy with liberty to the petitioners to
approach Tribunal.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 02.04.2026 AK
